title: ITOPF TIP 3 — Use of Booms in Oil Pollution Response (boom arrangement figures)
description: Boom types, failure modes and deployment configurations: U-configuration between two vessels, V-configuration by two vessels, spur deflection to shore, mooring arrangements and protection of intakes/power stations. | Figures: Figure 1 — Fence boom deflecting oil from moorings; Figure 2a — A solid flotation curtain boom with external ballast; Figure 2b — An external flotation fence boom with external flotation; Figure 2c — An inflatable curtain boom with a combined ballast; Figure 2d — Intertidal shore-sealing boom; Figure 3 — Boom failure modes (entrainment, drainage failure, critical accumulation, splash-over, submergence, planing)
